issue.title: [BUG] multiSession: listDeviceSessions() only returns 2 sessions when maximumSessions: 3

comments.body:
<!-- Greeting -->
Hi @Maxime-RiseVerse! I'm [Dosu](https://go.dosu.dev/dosubot) and I’m helping the better-auth team.

<!-- Answer -->
This looks like a bug in the multiSession plugin's session listing logic. The implementation of `listDeviceSessions()` only returns one session per user by filtering for unique user IDs, so if you have multiple sessions for the same user, only one will show up—even if all sessions exist in the database. This can cause the active session to be missing from the list if it gets filtered out by this logic. The `maximumSessions` setting only limits the number of multi-session cookies, not the number of sessions returned by the API. Setting `maximumSessions: 4` works as a workaround because it allows an extra cookie, but the underlying filtering logic is still the cause of the issue. [See source](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/blob/a39d09d3ff83b526fb9caf691d3bbcb3b7b2335b/packages/better-auth/src/plugins/multi-session/index.ts).

There’s no official documentation or known workaround for this behavior, but you could try mutating the response using the `customSession` plugin with `shouldMutateListDeviceSessionsEndpoint: true` if you need more control over the returned sessions. [See PR #3868](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/3868).

If you need all sessions to be listed, you’ll likely need to adjust the filtering logic in your local copy or wait for an upstream fix.

comments.body:
@dosu Thanks for the response, but I think
  you misunderstood the issue. I'm not using
  multiple sessions for the same user - I have
  3 completely different user accounts
  (different emails and user IDs).

  After debugging and reviewing the source
  code, I found the actual bug is in the after
  hook (line ~290) that creates multi-session
  cookies:

  ```typescript
  const currentMultiSessions =
      Object.keys(Object.fromEntries(cookies)).
  filter(isMultiSessionCookie).length
      + (cookieString.includes("session_token")
   ? 1 : 0);

  if (currentMultiSessions >=
  opts.maximumSessions) {
      return; // Bug: prevents creating the 3rd
   multi-session cookie
  }

  With maximumSessions: 3:
  - Login Account A → Creates _multi- cookie (0
   + 1 = 1 < 3) ✅
  - Login Account B → Creates _multi- cookie (1
   + 1 = 2 < 3) ✅
  - Login Account C → NO _multi- cookie (2 + 1
  = 3 >= 3) ❌

  Account C only gets the active session
  cookie, no _multi- cookie. When I switch away
   from Account C, it disappears because it has
   no _multi- cookie to preserve it.

  My debug logs confirm this - I only have 2
  _multi- cookies for 3 logged-in accounts.

  The workaround maximumSessions: 4 works
  because it allows the 3rd _multi- cookie to
  be created. The fix would be to adjust the
  counting logic to properly allow
  maximumSessions number of accounts.

  This clearly explains the bug is in cookie
  creation during login, not in the session
  listing logic.

comments.body:
<!-- Answer -->
You're absolutely right—the bug is in the multi-session cookie creation logic, not the session listing. The after hook in the multiSession plugin counts the current sessions like this:

```typescript
const currentMultiSessions =
  Object.keys(Object.fromEntries(cookies)).filter(isMultiSessionCookie).length
  + (cookieString.includes("session_token") ? 1 : 0);

if (currentMultiSessions >= opts.maximumSessions) {
  return;
}
```

This causes an off-by-one error: when maximumSessions is 3, only 2 `_multi-` cookies are created, so the third account never gets a persistent multi-session cookie. That's why your workaround (setting maximumSessions: 4) works, but it's not the intended behavior. The bug is confirmed in the current codebase and hasn't been addressed in any recent PRs or docs [[source]](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/blob/a39d09d3ff83b526fb9caf691d3bbcb3b7b2335b/packages/better-auth/src/plugins/multi-session/index.ts).

To fix this, the counting logic should be adjusted so that the number of persistent multi-session cookies matches maximumSessions. For example, you could remove the `+ (cookieString.includes("session_token") ? 1 : 0)` part, or refactor the logic to only count unique sessions.

Until this is fixed upstream, your workaround is the only way to ensure all sessions are preserved. This bug could affect any scenario where users expect to have the full number of concurrent sessions allowed by maximumSessions, regardless of browser or device.

7256.body:
Closes https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/issues/4490 and https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/issues/6184

<!-- This is an auto-generated description by cubic. -->
---
## Summary by cubic
Fixes duplicate multi-session cookies when the same user signs in multiple times on the same device. Old session cookies and records are removed, and max session limits are enforced; also adds refetch(queryParams) to useSession across clients.

- **Bug Fixes**
  - Delete existing multi-session cookies and sessions for the same user on sign-in, then set a single new cookie.
  - Recalculate and enforce maximumSessions after cleanup; added tests to verify cookie deletion and single-session state.

- **New Features**
  - Added refetch(queryParams) to useSession across clients with updated typings and tests.

<sup>Written for commit c93dd33bf1d9678dcfbeab3421438e1d1de95f15. Summary will update on new commits.</sup>

<!-- End of auto-generated description by cubic. -->

**1 issue found** across 7 files

<details>
<summary>Prompt for AI agents (all issues)</summary>

```text

Check if these issues are valid — if so, understand the root cause of each and fix them.


<file name="packages/better-auth/src/plugins/multi-session/index.ts">

<violation number="1" location="packages/better-auth/src/plugins/multi-session/index.ts:344">
P2: The maximum-session guard hardcodes `"session_token"`, so renaming the session cookie bypasses the limit. Use the configured cookie name instead of a literal.</violation>
</file>
